(1) The Hindus at Debai found two Hindu boys, names Moti son of Garao of Lucknow, aged 17, and Shankar son of Shamrao of Poona, aged 13, kidnapped from Karachi.
Moti was kidnapped by Muhammed Mekrani and sold through Abdullah Muhammed Dawwar.

(2) A boy Nuru, original name Gangaram son of Hanuman Bania of Tatta, Sind, aged 13, whom the above two boys had seen as slave, originally kidnapped by Rustam in Karachi and sold in Debai to Zaid.

(3) Musa bin Haider, aged 16, originally kidnapped from Karachi and resold through Muhammed bin Abdullah Dawwar. Musa was recovered by the Residency Agent.

(4) A Baluch boy named Muhammed bin Davud of Kasar Khand, aged 14. Kidnapped by four armed Baluchis and sold to a Baluchi called Muhammed.

(6) The Fidawis found a youth called Reza bin Rahmat Baluchi, aged 21. The youth had been originally kidnapped by Khan Muhammed.
